title: Scoped obstruction: P111 query transport exceeds the frozen U8 host budget
body:
The P111 decoder's smaller local COPY cost does not by itself pay for delivery
of its changed query from the existing U8 gather rows. This adds a scoped
negative result for a query inserted after U8 section A, with the old rows,
later frame contracts, and helper widths fixed, and with no mixing between
new carriers before the query hyperplane.

For all 112 punctures, exact rational elimination gives a unique expression
in the eligible old rows. Their required frames are pairwise incomparable and
cannot advance inside the query hyperplane while preserving the old tail.
The minimum transport profiles are `10 H5 + 6 H6`, `8 H5 + 10 H6`, or `26 H6`.

A favorable complete moment bound gives free entrance frames, no separate
centre charge, free compensation and interface work, and pooled fractional
rank-48 idle space. It credits each puncture's actual source and target paths,
plus the `H8 -> H7` COPY saving. Every case still exceeds one at historical
PR942 b; the minimum is enclosed by
`1.00000864736369386816835926810620863001514` and
`1.00000864736369386816835926935824150131476`.
A linear volume argument covers every positive replica count and mixtures of
punctures. This fixed-U8 class also fails at the larger b now selected by
PR1042. The proof does not apply to PR1042's word.

Reproduce with the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/shared-carrier-host/verify.py --out /tmp/shared-carrier-host-result.json
```

Expected: `PASS_SCOPED_FROZEN_U8_GATHER_OBSTRUCTION`. The command reconstructs
raw U8 from the pinned PR799 archive and U8 recipe. It checks all root/label
pairings, frame paths, unique row expressions, antichains, actual data-path
credits, and rational cost intervals. It compares power intervals against the
retained independent engine. Controls cover wrong query coefficients,
coalesced paths, old-row advances, and a mixed label chart. The free-query
control passes, so the transport charge is decisive.

Base: `abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf`. The PR1060 source head is
`d27499553138bde007f5b1163e65e71da1b18899`. The reconstructed U8 raw hash is
`090fd574747fbf9628e70cb9beb792732914cfa52e1df147579fe4dbccc68c5a`.
Only `research/shared-carrier-host/` is added. The selected frontier and
`upstream/` stay unchanged. This is a scoped negative result, not a new kappa
or a complete multiplication theorem. Changed A/B words, early mixing,
nonmonotone paths, and different owner geometry remain open.

The package records the initial direct-host failure, the endpoint escape,
and the reason for the row-reuse pivot. It credits PR717/968, PR1060, the
PR799/869/870 U8 lineage, PR858/890, and PR942. Prepared for Ali Romman with
substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review
is claimed.
